opportunities.name: City weekend trip planning and email
opportunities.description: For a destination city, gather Wikipedia population, timeanddate weather, a Booking.com hotel, Viator activities and an OpenTable dinner, save a summary note, then draft an email to a friend.
opportunities.site: wikipedia, timeanddate, booking, viator, opentable, notes, mail
steps: Search the city on Wikipedia and open the article to read the population
Search the city on timeanddate and open its weather page for the temperature
On Booking.com search the city with check-in/check-out dates and number of adults, open a top hotel and its Info & prices
On Viator search activity queries for the city and open top results
On OpenTable search the cuisine in the city for the date and open the top restaurant
Add a note summarising city, dates, population, temperature, hotel, activities, dinner
Open mail, fill To, Subject, and Body with the plan, then discard or send

instances.values: London, Nov 13-15, 2 adults, voco Camden Lock, Thames boat + Tower of London, London Indian, Benares, maya@example.com

opportunities.name: Booking.com hotel search and open details
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com for a destination with dates and adult count, then open the top hotel's Info & prices.
steps: Clear or click the destination field
Type destination and choose the first suggestion
Open date picker and select check-in and check-out dates
Set number of adults and click Done
Click Search
Open the top hotel result and click Info & prices

Select 'Search for <query>'
Open the first result

opportunities.name: Wikipedia and timeanddate city lookup
opportunities.description: Search a city on Wikipedia, open the article, then search it on timeanddate to see weather.
steps: Type city into Wikipedia search and open top suggestion
Open timeanddate and type city in its search box
Select the city result
Open weather page
